name: Dirty COW
fixed_in: 4.8.3 (upstream; stable branches have separate fixed releases)
notes: NVD documents affected upstream branches. Distribution kernels may backport the fix; version-only matching can over-report, especially on vendor kernels.

name: Dirty Pipe
notes: Range from NVD affected configurations. Vendor kernels may backport fixes; version-only matching is advisory.

name: Netfilter Heap Out-of-Bounds Write
notes: Flaw in net/netfilter/x_tables.c during IPT_SO_SET_REPLACE. Stable branches received separate backports.

name: Ubuntu OverlayFS Privilege Escalation
notes: Ubuntu-specific overlayfs/shiftfs capability checking flaw in user namespaces. Standard upstream kernel ranges do not necessarily contain this Ubuntu patch flaw.

name: OverlayFS SUID Copy-Up
notes: Improper SUID permission copy-up when mounting overlayfs in unprivileged user namespaces.

name: eBPF Sign-Extension Vulnerability
notes: Verifier failed to correctly track 32-bit arithmetic sign extension in kernel/bpf/verifier.c.

name: Route4 cls_route Heap Double-Free (DirtyCred)
notes: Use-after-free / double-free flaw in net/sched/cls_route.c enabling credential object reuse.
